firstSentence: Deploy air-gapped clinical language models within private VPCs for multi-hospital trusts, providing real-time telemetry and strict data localization compliant with Indian health data mandates.
heroImageAlt: Private VPC Air-Gapped Clinical LLM Deployment Telemetry for Hospital Trusts
paragraphs: Multi-hospital healthcare trusts managing hospital networks across multiple Indian cities struggle to deploy unified clinical intelligence copilots without exposing patient health records to public cloud security risks. Inter-hospital data sharing for rare disease consultations and oncology tumor boards is hindered by strict data protection laws and hospital trust fiduciaries. Centralized public cloud LLMs risk massive data breaches and fail during wide-area network fiber cuts.

Our sovereign healthcare trust architecture deploys air-gapped private virtual private clouds (VPCs) across sovereign Indian regions (AWS ap-south-1 Mumbai and CtrlS Hyderabad). Member hospitals connect to the central trust inference cluster over dedicated encrypted IPsec VPN tunnels with mutual TLS 1.3 authentication. Deep learning reasoning runtimes execute on dedicated NVIDIA H100 NVLink nodes with zero outbound internet routing.

The trust telemetry state machine monitors model latency, token throughput, and clinical safety guardrails across all hospital branches in real time. It enforces multi-tenant patient record isolation, ensuring that one hospital's patient records cannot be accessed by clinicians at another branch without explicit cross-facility consent artifacts. Automated Delta WAL checkpointing guarantees that uncompleted clinical note sessions recover within 1.2ms without loss of medical context.

Statutory compliance satisfies the National Health Policy digital standards, ABDM Health Data Management Policy, and Section 8(5) of the DPDP Act 2023. Real-time Prometheus and Grafana dashboards display clinical token consumption, latency percentiles, and medical terminology extraction accuracy, supporting 3,450 sustained queries per second across 25 trust hospitals.

faqs.question: How does the system ensure patient records from Hospital A are not visible to Hospital B?
faqs.answer: Every clinical request carries an encrypted ABDM-compliant hospital branch certificate; data is isolated in separate tenant memory partitions with independent cryptographic keys.

faqs.question: What happens if the wide-area network connection between a branch hospital and the private VPC fails?
faqs.answer: Branch hospitals maintain lightweight local edge caching nodes that buffer clinical notes and allow offline consultation recording until network connectivity restores.

faqs.question: Does the system support clinical decision support for multi-specialty tumor boards?
faqs.answer: Yes. The model can synthesize medical records, pathology reports, and genetic sequencing summaries from multiple departments into unified clinical dossiers.
